buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment

PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. Bidder's attention is drawn to the scope of work and ATC uploaded by the buyer where compl ete details of manpower to be hired, duration of work, nature of work to be handled by skilled/uns killed workers, has been clearly mentioned. Bidders are required to go through the complete detail s before quoting their bids. 2. Bidder must have executed maintanence/manning & operation (M&O) works for el ectrical installations (as per d(v) category). It is specifically intimated that in the absen ce of non-execution of M&O works (as stated above), bid shall not be treated as qualifi ed and shall be rejected. 3. Bidder shall upload the details of similar works executed by him in the past to prove his eligibi lity. A separate consolidated summary of works executed shall also be uploaded to also see the eligibility of bidder at a glance. 4. Category of 'Mechanic-Machine' as uploaded in the system shall be amended to read as 'Oper ator' as per BOQ, as the category of Operator does not exist in the GeM system for selection while uploading. 5. Application alongwith demand draft of Rs 500.00 towards tender cost as mentioned in ATC is required to be uploaded on site as well as the hard copies of the same are required to reach the b uyer by opening date. 6. The bid will be passed in techincal evaluation only if the bidder meets the various eligibility cr iteria mentioned in ATC as uploaded. 7. Contractors not enlisted with MES will be required to upload copy of Police Verific ation/Police Clearance certificate from Police Authority of the area where registered off ice of the firm is located/notarized copy of valid passport of Proprietor, each Partner or each Director, as applicable.
